ios.structure: NavigationStack, grouped List sections, safeAreaInset bottom feedback, sheet details
ios.type: System semantic styles; monospaced caption for addresses and invoices
ios.materials: Native List surfaces, secondary text, separators and bar material
ios.announcements: UIAccessibility announcement for busy, status and error changes

android.structure: Material 3 Scaffold, TopAppBar, LazyColumn and inset-aware bottom feedback Surface
android.type: Default Material 3 type roles; monospaced bodySmall for addresses and invoices
android.layout: 20dp content padding; 12dp item spacing; 6dp address-stack spacing; footer 20dp horizontal/8dp vertical padding with 12dp gaps
android.elevation: 3dp tonal elevation for the feedback Surface
android.announcements: Polite live region on operation feedback

components.name: Wallet actions
components.implementation: SwiftUI List buttons and Material filled/outlined/text buttons; disabled while busy

components.name: Persistent fields
components.implementation: SwiftUI LabeledContent for endpoint and amount fields; Material OutlinedTextField labels; masked recovery input

components.name: Wallet values
components.implementation: Wrapping selectable monospaced addresses/invoices; iOS ShareLink

components.name: Pinned operation feedback
components.implementation: Status, busy indicator or failure with Details outside scrolling content

components.name: Error details
components.implementation: Selectable full error in native iOS sheet or scrollable Android AlertDialog, dismissed with Done

native.preview: Native components have no HTML/CSS renderer; browser approximations and unobserved tonal ramps are intentionally omitted.

evidence.scope: Ship disposition covers persistent iOS field labels and pinned feedback/error details only.
limits: No approved comp, FORM seed or QUALITY BAR card
Transient busy rendering and announcement implementation checked in source; delivered announcements unverified
evidence.notCanonized: Small iOS tint rounding drift remains implementation detail; no new palette token or repair.

narrative.overview: Mode: Operate. The SwiftUI and Compose examples use their platform's controls, type and semantic surfaces to expose real RegTest wallet state. The green action tint is the only custom palette decision.
keyCharacteristics: System-scaled text and selectable wallet data.
Persistent operation feedback with dismissible error details.

rules.name: The Action Tint Rule
rules.body: Use green for actions; use platform error and destructive roles for failures and exit actions.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Keep semantic text styles and system scaling; let long labels and values wrap.

dos: **Do** preserve native controls, safe areas, text scaling and minimum touch targets.
**Do** keep populated field labels, operation status and error details available while tasks scroll.
**Do** show actual RegTest balances, addresses, outcomes and empty states.
donts: **Don't** replace native navigation with custom navigation or decorative card stacks.
**Don't** add decorative charts, synthetic activity or an invented brand type scale.
**Don't** treat simulator captures or source inspection as hardware or screen-reader verification.
